# Reference audit — Stage 1 writing v0.9

**Citation mechanism:** both PDFs compile with `\bibliographystyle{IEEEtran}` and `\bibliography{../shared/bibliography/references}`; the shared `.bib` is the authority. `main.bbl` is generated by BibTeX, not manually edited.

| Key | Metadata and identifiers checked | Public resolver |
|---|---|---|
| `shannon1949` | C. E. Shannon; Bell System Technical Journal 28(1), 59–98, 1949 | Historical journal scan (no invented DOI) |
| `bryant1986` | R. E. Bryant; IEEE Transactions on Computers C-35(8), 677–691, 1986 | https://doi.org/10.1109/TC.1986.1676819 |
| `brayton1984` | R. K. Brayton et al., book, 1984 (publisher Kluwer); corrected Curtis T. McMullen name | https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4613-2821-6 |
| `mishchenko2006` | A. Mishchenko et al., DAC 2006, 532–535 | https://doi.org/10.1145/1146909.1147048 |
| `abc` | Berkeley ABC source and documentation | https://github.com/berkeley-abc/abc |
| `coursehandout` | Privately distributed course specification; no public URL supplied | none; do not fabricate link |

URLs/DOIs were cross-checked against their publishers or maintained project page in November 2026. **Not every paper needs a PDF download URL**: a DOI and full scholarly metadata suffice. Online software needs a working URL and access date. This is an academic source list, not a claim that all DOI targets provide free access.

## Build test
Run `pdflatex main`, `bibtex main`, `pdflatex main` twice in each document directory, inspect `main.blg` and `main.log` for unresolved references. A missing BibTeX backend should not be silently replaced by a hand-written bibliography.
